about: char-port-2 features (docs/char-port-2/PLAN.md), each off unless named in SLOP_PORT (comma-separated). face_types.load() merges a feature's per-class values into each type's records; a class is the type id without its line letter. With SLOP_PORT unset every type and file is built exactly as before.

jaw.about: S1: the lower face's taper toward the drawing (chin over jaw 0.507, jaw 0.952 of the pupil-to-chin span; docs/char-port-2/s1). cage_head's jaw_taper and chin_taper: fractional offsets of the local half-width, the chin's below 0.095 H, the jaw's from 0.15 to 0.27 H. Per-person spread stays with the identity bones J_Id_Jaw (jaw_width) and J_Id_Chin (chin_width). S7: `rise` (0.25, 0.7; the men's classes 0.3, 0.8), the jaw line climbing out of the chin sooner below a quarter of its height (cage_head Plan.jaw_line): the cage's jaw had stayed at the chin's height 0.18-0.23 H behind it, where the reference's has risen (cage_accept's w30 at 0.04 H; docs/char-port-2/s7/cage-accept.md).

jaw_shell.about: S1: the inside-out jaw line over the whole underside, from the jaw line to the neck's ring (cage_head.CageFace._underside_shell), in place of the first ring under the jaw, whose copy faces away at portrait height and draws nothing in front (docs/char-port-2/s0).

paint.about: S2: Cora's face paint as parameters of the generator's landmarks (face_paint.PAINT): a broad warm blush with a band over the nose's bridge, a darker mouth crease, a diffuse lower lip and a shade under it, the nose's underside shade, a glint at its tip and two soft filled nostrils (docs/char-port-2/s2).

neck.about: S2: the neck shade as Cora's (cage_head.NECK_SHADE): a multiply of the skin, whole under the jaw, full to 8 mm below the chin and clear by 45 mm, its edge rising toward the sides and fading round the back (docs/char-port-2/s2).

ink.about: S4: the lid, its wing, flicks and fringe, the outer lower lid and the brow as ink on carriers (living/tools/blender/ink_carriers.py), on the types' shared ink page (lookdev/types/types.eyes.ink.png, docs/HANDMADE_COMPOSED.md), in place of the lid band, lash cards, lower line and brow strip; an opaque lid core keeps the lid at play distance (docs/char-port-2/s4).

hair.about: S5: hair styles laid out for the handmade-hair profile on the shared hair-mask pages (lookdev/styles/hair/hair-masks.png and -1, -2: 4096 at 1 mm a texel, docs/HANDMADE_COMPOSED.md): each piece its own UV island by its own lengths (hair.page_layout), a highlight on the upper hair and a pale parting (_HIGHLIGHT and the mask's R), lock lines grouped into locks from the notches between a sheet's points (G), main's strands under the bands at low contrast (B), and one tag-relative profile with anchors for black, brown, blond and grey (living/tools/characters/hair_page.py; docs/char-port-2/s5).

masters.about: S6: hair masters, a cut as a named set of parameters in the generator (hair.MASTERS): swept_braid, Cora's cut, its rear layers as stations, wide locks and companions joining a three-strand plait at staggered heights, the plait lifted at its start for the game camera and its crossings lit (docs/char-port-2/s6). Written as styles (`swept_braid`, its cuts and `.collar`) only with the flag.

faceprop.about: S6b: the face's width against its eyes toward Cora's drawing (the face's outline at the cheek row, 0.030 m under the eyes, over the eye spacing, iris to iris, the ears left out: 1.75; docs/char-port-2/s6b). One width factor a class on the type's sections (w15, w30, wide), whole over the cheeks and fading to none by the chin and above the eyes (face_types.faceprop); the eyes, nose and mouth as they are, the ears carried in with the skull's side. A class's three lines take the same factor, so their differences stay.

eyes.about: S7, must-fix 1: no eye white or iris above a closed lid. The eye's parts (the white's bowl, the iris and its lights) are placed against the open eye's plane in every face state (cage_head CageFace._eye), not against a plane fitted to the lids' ring as the state leaves it: eye-joy folds the ring onto one arc, and a plane fitted to a line tipped the iris forward through the skin above it (docs/char-port-2/s7).

beard.about: S7, must-fix 3: the man's and elder's beards, a solid dark block over the lower face, by the paused char-4-body-joins beard work (8d1659ec5 and 537eb0457's face paint only; the neck lift is a later body pass, PLAN.md §9). Stubble and beards drawn in hairs at a density, their upper edge feathered, cheek hair thinning to the sideburn and the mouth's corners bare (face_paint.paint_skin, head_form.Head.beard_cover); the short beard's core near opaque; the overlay's alpha is the painted coverage (person.make_overlay); the far beard 1.5 mm off the skin (person.far_beard); the far beards share one grey mean (shade_mean FAR_BEARD).
